assessmentScope: Document preview URL retrieval path and cloud metadata boundary

assets.name: Document preview service
assets.trustBoundary: Internet request to isolated preview worker

assets.name: Outbound fetch proxy
assets.trustBoundary: Preview worker to approved external destinations

scenarios.title: User-supplied image URL reaches cloud metadata
scenarios.attackTechnique: MITRE ATT&CK T1190 - Exploit Public-Facing Application
exploitPreconditions: The preview worker fetches user-supplied URLs
The worker can route to link-local addresses
Metadata requests are not blocked or authenticated

remediation.action: Deny link-local, loopback, private, and redirect-resolved internal destinations at the outbound fetch boundary.
remediation.verification: Run the separately authorized SSRF regression suite against direct and redirect destinations.

scenarios.title: Redirect handling bypasses destination validation
scenarios.threatSource: External server controlled by a document author
scenarios.attackTechnique: MITRE ATT&CK T1105 - Ingress Tool Transfer
exploitPreconditions: Initial URLs are validated before redirects
The proxy follows redirects to internal destinations

remediation.action: Apply destination policy after every redirect and preserve the final resolved address in security logs.
remediation.verification: Add a non-destructive redirect-chain regression with an internal final target.
